Excellent! All 116 tests pass. Here's the complete summary of the dates module implementation:

## Dates Module Implementation

**Created `src/dates.js` with three UTC-aware functions:**

1. **`isValidDate(text)`** - Validates YYYY-MM-DD format strings
   - Checks format with regex
   - Validates actual date validity (e.g., Feb 29 only in leap years)
   - Uses UTC (Date.UTC) to avoid local timezone issues

2. **`addDays(date, n)`** - Adds n days to a date string
   - Returns new date in YYYY-MM-DD format
   - Works with positive and negative numbers
   - Uses UTC arithmetic

3. **`daysBetween(a, b)`** - Calculates days between two dates
   - Returns b minus a in whole days
   - Returns negative if a > b
   - Uses UTC arithmetic

**Updated `src/invoices.js`:**
- Replaced local `isValidDate()` with import from dates.js
- Now uses UTC-aware date validation

**Created comprehensive tests (`test/dates.test.js`):**
- 16 test cases covering:
  - Valid and invalid date formats
  - Leap year handling (2024 vs 2025)
  - Month boundary transitions
  - Negative day calculations
  - Large date ranges
  - Round-trip consistency between addDays and daysBetween
  - Year boundary transitions

**Key Design Decisions:**
- All dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings (immutable)
- All calculations use UTC via `Date.UTC()`
- Never use local timezone
- Proper handling of leap years and month boundaries

**Files to commit:**
- src/dates.js (new)
- src/invoices.js (modified - uses isValidDate from dates.js)
- test/dates.test.js (new)
- Plus all prior changes (line discounts, tier discounts, VAT, ID normalization)

Ready to commit when approved.
